Joshua: Vayehi achare mot moshe eved Adonai vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua bin-nun mesharet moshe lemor
Moshe avdi met veatta kum avor et-hayyarden hazze atta vechal-haam hazze el-haaretz asher anochi noten lahem livne yisrael
Kal-makom asher tidroch kaf-raglechem bo lachem netattiv kaasher dibbarti el-moshe
Mehammidbar vehallevanon hazze vead-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat kol eretz hachittim vead-hayyam haggadol mevo hashshamesh yihye gevulchem
Lo-yityatztzev ish lefanecha kol yeme chayyecha kaasher hayiti im-moshe ehye immach lo arpecha velo eezvekka
Chazak veematz ki atta tanchil et-haam hazze et-haaretz asher-nishbati laavotam latet lahem
Rak chazak veematz meod lishmor laasot kechal-hattora asher tzivvecha moshe avdi al-tasur mimmennu yamin usmol lemaan taskil bechol asher telech
Lo-yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha vehagita bo yomam valayela lemaan tishmor laasot kechal-hakkatuv bo ki-az tatzliach et-derachecha veaz taskil
Halo tziviticha chazak veematz al-taarotz veal-techat ki immecha Adonai elohecha bechol asher telech
Vayetzav yehoshua et-shotre haam lemor
Ivru bekerev hammachane vetzauu et-haam lemor hachinu lachem tzeda ki beod sheloshet yamim attem ovrim et-hayyarden hazze lavo lareshet et-haaretz asher Adonai elohechem noten lachem lerishtah
Velaruveni velaggadi velachatzi shevet hamnashshe amar yehoshua lemor
Zachor et-haddavar asher tziva etchem moshe eved-Adonai lemor Adonai elohechem meniach lachem venatan lachem et-haaretz hazzot
Neshechem tappechem umiknechem yeshvu baaretz asher natan lachem moshe beever hayyarden veattem taavru chamushim lifne achechem kol gibbore hachayil vaazartem otam

Ad asher-yaniach Adonai laachechem kachem veyarshu gam-hemma et-haaretz asher-Adonai elohechem noten lahem veshavtem leeretz yerushshatchem virishtem otah asher natan lachem moshe eved Adonai beever hayyarden mizrach hashshamesh
Vayyaanu et-yehoshua lemor kol asher-tzivitanu naase veel-kal-asher tishlachenu nelech
Kechol asher-shamanu el-moshe ken nishma elecha rak yihye Adonai elohecha immach kaasher haya im-moshe
Kal-ish asher-yamre et-picha velo-yishma et-devarecha lechol asher-tetzavennu yumat rak chazak veematz
Vayyishlach yehoshua-bin-nun min-hashshittim shenayim-anashim meraggelim cheresh lemor lechu reu et-haaretz veet-yericho vayyelchu vayyavou bet-ishsha zona ushmah rachav vayyishkevu-shamma
Vayyeamar lemelech yericho lemor hinne anashim bau henna hallayela mibbene yisrael lachpor et-haaretz
Vayyishlach melech yericho el-rachav lemor hotzii haanashim habbaim elayich asher-bau levetech ki lachpor et-kal-haaretz bau
Vattikkach haishsha et-shene haanashim vattitzpeno vattomer ken bau ela haanashim velo yadati meayin hemma
Vayehi hashshaar lisgor bachoshech vehaanashim yatzau lo yadati ana halchu haanashim ridfu maher acharehem ki tassigum
Vehi heelatam haggaga vattitmenem befishte haetz haaruchot lah al-haggag
Vehaanashim radfu acharehem derech hayyarden al hammaberot vehashshaar sagaru achare kaasher yatzu harodfim acharehem
Vehemma terem yishkavun vehi alta alehem al-haggag
Vattomer el-haanashim yadati ki-natan Adonai lachem et-haaretz vechi-nafla ematchem alenu vechi namogu kal-yoshve haaretz mippenechem
Ki shamanu et asher-hovish Adonai et-me yam-suf mippenechem betzetchem mimmitzrayim vaasher asitem lishne malche haemori asher beever hayyarden lesichon ulog asher hecheramtem otam
Vannishma vayyimmas levavenu velo-kama od ruach beish mippenechem ki Adonai elohechem hu elohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal-haaretz mittachat
Veatta hishshavu-na li ba-Adonai ki-asiti immachem chased vaasitem gam-attem im-bet avi chesed untattem li ot emet
Vehachayitem et-avi veet-immi veet-acha achyota veet kal-asher lahem vehitztzaltem et-nafshotenu mimmavet
Vayyomru lah haanashim nafshenu tachtechem lamut im lo taggidu et-devarenu ze vehaya betet-Adonai lanu et-haaretz veasinu immach chesed veemet
Vattoridem bachevel bead hachallon ki vetah bekir hachoma uvachoma hi yoshavet
Vattomer lahem hahara lechu pen-yifgeu vachem harodfim venachbetem shamma sheloshet yamim ad shov harodfim veachar telchu ledarkechem
Vayyomru eleha haanashim nekiyyim anachnu mishshevuatech hazze asher hishbatanu
Hinne anachnu vaim baaretz et-tikvat chut hashshani hazze tiksheri bachallon asher horadtenu vo veet-avich veet-immech veet-achayich veet kal-bet avich taasfi elayich habbayeta
Vehaya kol asher-yetze middalte vetech hachutza damo verosho vaanachnu nekiyyim vechol asher yihye ittach babbayit damo veroshenu im-yad tihye-bo
Veim-taggidi et-devarenu ze vehayinu nekiyyim mishshevuatech asher hishbatanu
Vattomer kedivrechem ken-hu vatteshallechem vayyelechu vattikshor et-tikvat hashshani bachallon
Vayyelchu vayyavou hahara vayyeshvu sham sheloshet yamim ad-shavu harodfim vayevakshu harodfim bechal-hadderech velo matzau
Vayyashuvu shene haanashim vayyerdu mehahar vayyaavru vayyavou el-yehoshua bin-nun vayesapperu-lo et kal-hammotzot otam
Vayyomru el-yehoshua ki-natan Adonai beyadenu et-kal-haaretz vegam-namogu kal-yoshve haaretz mippanenu
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyisu mehashshittim vayyavou ad-hayyarden hu vechal-bene yisrael vayyalinu sham terem yaavoru
Vayehi miktze sheloshet yamim vayyaavru hashshotrim bekerev hammachane
Vayetzauu et-haam lemor kirotchem et aron berit-Adonai elohechem vehakkohanim halviyyim nosim oto veattem tisu mimmekomchem vahalachtem acharav
Ach rachok yihye benechem uvenav kealpayim amma bammidda al-tikrevu elav lemaan asher-tedu et-hadderech asher telchu-vah ki lo avartem badderech mittemol shilshom
Vayyomer yehoshua el-haam hitkaddashu ki machar yaase Adonai bekirbechem niflaot
Vayyomer yehoshua el-hakkohanim lemor seu et-aron habberit veivru lifne haam vayyisu et-aron habberit vayyelchu lifne haam
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua hayyom hazze achel gaddelcha beene kal-yisrael asher yedun ki kaasher hayiti im-moshe ehye immach
Veatta tetzave et-hakkohanim nose aron-habberit lemor kevoachem ad-ketze me hayyarden bayyarden taamodu
Vayyomer yehoshua el-bene yisrael goshu henna veshimu et-divre Adonai elohechem
Vayyomer yehoshua bezot tedun ki el cha bekirbechem vehoresh yorish mippenechem et-hakkenaani veet-hachitti veet-hachivi veet-happerizzi veet-haggirgashi vehaemori vehayevusi
Hinne aron habberit adon kal-haaretz over lifnechem bayyarden
Veatta kechu lachem shene asar ish mishshivte yisrael ish-echad ish-echad lashshavet
Vehaya kenoach kappot ragle hakkohanim nose aron Adonai adon kal-haaretz beme hayyarden me hayyarden yikkaretun hammayim hayyordim milmala veyaamdu ned echad
Vayehi binsoa haam meaholehem laavor et-hayyarden vehakkohanim nose haaron habberit lifne haam
Uchvo nose haaron ad-hayyarden veragle hakkohanim nose haaron nitbelu biktze hammayim vehayyarden male al-kal-gedotav kol yeme katzir
Vayyaamdu hammayim hayyordim milmala kamu ned-echad harchek meod meadam hair asher mitztzad tzartan vehayyordim al yam haarava yam-hammelach tammu nichratu vehaam avru neged yericho
Vayyaamdu hakkohanim nose haaron berit-Adonai becharava betoch hayyarden hachen vechal-yisrael ovrim becharava ad asher-tammu kal-haggoy laavor et-hayyarden
Vayehi kaasher-tammu chal-haggoy laavor et-hayyarden f vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua lemor
Kechu lachem min-haam shenem asar anashim ish-echad ish-echad mishshavet
Vetzauu otam lemor seu-lachem mizze mittoch hayyarden mimmatztzav ragle hakkohanim hachin shettem-esre avanim vehaavartem otam immachem vehinnachtem otam bammalon asher-talinu vo hallayela
Vayyikra yehoshua el-shenem heasar ish asher hechin mibbene yisrael ish-echad ish-echad mishshavet
Vayyomer lahem yehoshua ivru lifne aron Adonai elohechem el-toch hayyarden veharimu lachem ish even achat al-shichmo lemispar shivte vene-yisrael
Lemaan tihye zot ot bekirbechem ki-yishalun benechem machar lemor ma haavanim haelle lachem
Vaamartem lahem asher nichretu meme hayyarden mippene aron berit-Adonai beavro bayyarden nichretu me hayyarden vehau haavanim haelle lezikkaron livne yisrael ad-olam

Vayyaasu-chen bene-yisrael kaasher tziva yehoshua vayyisu shette-esre avanim mittoch hayyarden kaasher dibber Adonai el-yehoshua lemispar shivte vene-yisrael vayyaavirum immam el-hammalon vayyannichum sham
Ushtem esre avanim hekim yehoshua betoch hayyarden tachat matztzav ragle hakkohanim nose aron habberit vayyihyu sham ad hayyom hazze
Vehakkohanim nose haaron omdim betoch hayyarden ad tom kal-haddavar asher-tziva Adonai et-yehoshua ledabber el-haam kechol asher-tziva moshe et-yehoshua vayemaharu haam vayyaavoru
Vayehi kaasher-tam kal-haam laavor vayyaavor aron-Adonai vehakkohanim lifne haam
Vayyaavru bene-reuven uvne-gad vachatzi shevet hamnashshe chamushim lifne bene yisrael kaasher dibber alehem moshe
Kearbaim elef chalutze hatztzava avru lifne Adonai lammilchama el arvot yericho
Bayyom hahu giddal Adonai et-yehoshua beene kal-yisrael vayyiru oto kaasher yaru et-moshe kal-yeme chayyav
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua lemor
Tzave et-hakkohanim nose aron haedut veyaalu min-hayyarden
Vayetzav yehoshua et-hakkohanim lemor alu min-hayyarden
Vayehi kaalot hakkohanim nose aron berit-Adonai mittoch hayyarden nitteku kappot ragle hakkohanim el hecharava vayyashuvu me-hayyarden limkomam vayyelchu chitmol-shilshom al-kal-gedotav
Vehaam alu min-hayyarden beasor lachodesh harishon vayyachanu baggilgal biktze mizrach yericho
Veet shettem esre haavanim haelle asher lakchu min-hayyarden hekim yehoshua baggilgal
Vayyomer el-bene yisrael lemor asher yishalun benechem machar et-avotam lemor ma haavanim haelle
Vehodatem et-benechem lemor bayyabbasha avar yisrael et-hayyarden hazze
Asher-hovish Adonai elohechem et-me hayyarden mippenechem ad-avrechem kaasher asa Adonai elohechem leyam-suf asher-hovish mippanenu ad-avrenu
Lemaan daat kal-amme haaretz et-yad Adonai ki chazaka hi lemaan yeratem et-Adonai elohechem kal-hayyamim

Vayehi chishmoa kal-malche haemori asher beever hayyarden yamma vechal-malche hakkenaani asher al-hayyam et asher-hovish Adonai et-me hayyarden mippene vene-yisrael avram vayyimmas levavam velo-haya vam od ruach mippene bene-yisrael
Baet hahi amar Adonai el-yehoshua ase lecha charvot tzurim veshuv mol et-bene-yisrael shenit
Vayyaas-lo yehoshua charvot tzurim vayyamal et-bene yisrael el-givat haaralot
Veze haddavar asher-mal yehoshua kal-haam hayyotze mimmitzrayim hazzecharim kol anshe hammilchama metu vammidbar badderech betzetam mimmitzrayim
Ki-mulim hau kal-haam hayyotzim vechal-haam hayyillodim bammidbar badderech betzetam mimmitzrayim lo-malu

Ki arbaim shana halchu vene-yisrael bammidbar ad-tom kal-haggoy anshe hammilchama hayyotzim mimmitzrayim asher lo-shamu bekol Adonai asher nishba Adonai lahem levilti harotam et-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laavotam latet lanu eretz zavat chalav udvash
Veet-benehem hekim tachtam otam mal yehoshua ki-arelim hau ki lo-malu otam baddarech
Vayehi kaasher-tammu chal-haggoy lehimmol vayyeshvu tachtam bammachane ad chaotam
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua hayyom galloti et-cherpat mitzrayim mealechem vayyikra shem hammakom hahu gilgal ad hayyom hazze
Vayyachanu vene-yisrael baggilgal vayyaasu et-happesach bearbaa asar yom lachodesh baerev bearvot yericho
Vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmachorat happesach matztzot vekaluy beetzem hayyom hazze
Vayyishbot hamman mimmachorat beachlam meavur haaretz velo-haya od livne yisrael man vayyochlu mittevuat eretz kenaan bashshana hahi
Vayehi bihyot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vehinne-ish omed lenegdo vecharbo shelufa beyado vayyelech yehoshua elav vayyomer lo halanu atta im-letzarenu
Vayyomer lo ki ani sar-tzeva-Adonai atta vati vayyippol yehoshua el-panav artza vayyishtachu vayyomer lo ma adoni medabber el-avdo
Vayyomer sar-tzeva Adonai el-yehoshua shal-naalcha meal raglecha ki hammakom asher atta omed alav kodesh hu vayyaas yehoshua ken
Viricho sogeret umsuggeret mippene bene yisrael en yotze veen ba
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua ree natatti veyadcha et-yericho veet-malkah gibbore hechayil
Vesabbotem et-hair kol anshe hammilchama hakkef et-hair paam echat ko taase sheshet yamim
Veshiva chohanim yisu shiva shofrot hayyovlim lifne haaron uvayyom hashshevii tasobbu et-hair sheva peamim vehakkohanim yitkeu bashshofarot
Vehaya bimshoch bekeren hayyovel keshamachem et-kol hashshofar yariu chal-haam terua gedola venafla chomat hair tachteha vealu haam ish negdo
Vayyikra yehoshua bin-nun el-hakkohanim vayyomer alehem seu et-aron habberit veshiva chohanim yisu shiva shofrot yovlim lifne aron Adonai
Vayyomer el-haam ivru vesobbu et-hair vehechalutz yaavor lifne aron Adonai
Vayehi keemor yehoshua el-haam veshiva hakkohanim nosim shiva shofrot hayyovlim lifne Adonai avru vetaku bashshofarot vaaron berit Adonai holech acharehem
Vehechalutz holech lifne hakkohanim toke hashshofarot vehamassef holech achare haaron haloch vetakoa bashshofarot
Veet-haam tziva yehoshua lemor lo tariu velo-tashmiu et-kolchem velo-yetze mippichem davar ad yom amri alechem hariu vahariotem
Vayyassev aron-Adonai et-hair hakkef paam echat vayyavou hammachane vayyalinu bammachane
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyisu hakkohanim et-aron Adonai
Veshiva hakkohanim nosim shiva shofrot hayyovlim lifne aron Adonai holchim haloch vetaku bashshofarot vehechalutz holech lifnehem vehamassef holech achare aron Adonai haloch vetakoa bashshofarot
Vayyasobbu et-hair bayyom hashsheni paam achat vayyashuvu hammachane ko asu sheshet yamim
Vayehi bayyom hashshevii vayyashkimu kaalot hashshachar vayyasobbu et-hair kammishpat hazze sheva peamim rak bayyom hahu savvu et-hair sheva peamim
Vayehi bappaam hashsheviit taku hakkohanim bashshofarot vayyomer yehoshua el-haam hariu ki-natan Adonai lachem et-hair
Vehayeta hair cherem hi vechal-asher-bah la-Adonai rak rachav hazzona tichye hi vechal-asher ittah babbayit ki hechbeata et-hammalachim asher shalachnu
Verak-attem shimru min-hacherem pen-tacharimu ulkachtem min-hacherem vesamtem et-machane yisrael lecherem vaachartem oto
Vechol kesef vezahav uchle nechoshet uvarzel kodesh hu la-Adonai otzar Adonai yavo
Vayyara haam vayyitkeu bashshofarot vayehi chishmoa haam et-kol hashshofar vayyariu haam terua gedola vattippol hachoma tachteha vayyaal haam haira ish negdo vayyilkedu et-hair
Vayyacharimu et-kal-asher bair meish vead-ishsha minnaar vead-zaken vead shor vase vachamor lefi-charev
Velishnayim haanashim hamraggelim et-haaretz amar yehoshua bou bet-haishsha hazzona vehotziu mishsham et-haishsha veet-kal-asher-lah kaasher nishbatem lah
Vayyavou hannearim hamraggelim vayyotziu et-rachav veet-aviha veet-immah veet-acheha veet-kal-asher-lah veet kal-mishpechoteha hotziu vayyannichum michutz lemachane yisrael
Vehair sarfu vaesh vechal-asher-bah rak hakkesef vehazzahav uchle hannechoshet vehabbarzel natnu otzar bet-Adonai
Veet-rachav hazzona veet-bet aviha veet-kal-asher-lah hecheya yehoshua vatteshev bekerev yisrael ad hayyom hazze ki hechbia et-hammalachim asher-shalach yehoshua leraggel et-yericho
Vayyashba yehoshua baet hahi lemor arur haish lifne Adonai asher yakum uvana et-hair hazzot et-yericho bivchoro yeyassedenna uvitziro yatztziv delateha
Vayehi Adonai et-yehoshua vayehi shamo bechal-haaretz
Vayyimalu vene-yisrael maal bacherem vayyikkach achan ben-karmi ven-zavdi ven-zerach lematte yehuda min-hacherem vayyichar-af Adonai bivne yisrael
Vayyishlach yehoshua anashim miricho haa asher im-bet aven mikkedem levet-el vayyomer alehem lemor alu veraggelu et-haaretz vayyaalu haanashim vayeraggelu et-haa
Vayyashuvu el-yehoshua vayyomru elav al-yaal kal-haam kealpayim ish o kishloshet alafim ish yaalu veyakku et-haa al-teyagga-shamma et-kal-haam ki meat hemma
Vayyaalu min-haam shamma kishloshet alafim ish vayyanusu lifne anshe haa
Vayyakku mehem anshe haa kishloshim veshishsha ish vayyirdefum lifne hashshaar ad-hashshevarim vayyakkum bammorad vayyimmas levav-haam vayehi lemayim
Vayyikra yehoshua simlotav vayyippol al-panav artza lifne aron Adonai ad-haerev hu vezikne yisrael vayyaalu afar al-rosham
Vayyomer yehoshua ahah adona Adonai lama heavarta haavir et-haam hazze et-hayyarden latet otanu beyad haemori lehaavidenu velu hoalnu vanneshev beever hayyarden
Bi adona ma omar achare asher hafach yisrael oref lifne oyevav
Veyishmeu hakkenaani vechol yoshve haaretz venasabbu alenu vehichritu et-shemenu min-haaretz uma-taase leshimcha haggadol
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua kum lach lamma ze atta nofel al-panecha
Chata yisrael vegam avru et-beriti asher tziviti otam vegam lakchu min-hacherem vegam ganvu vegam kichashu vegam samu vichlehem
Velo yuchlu bene yisrael lakum lifne oyevehem oref yifnu lifne oyevehem ki hau lecherem lo osif lihyot immachem im-lo tashmidu hacherem mikkirbechem
Kum kaddesh et-haam veamarta hitkaddeshu lemachar ki cho amar Adonai elohe yisrael cherem bekirbecha yisrael lo tuchal lakum lifne oyevecha ad-hasirchem hacherem mikkirbechem

Venikravtem babboker leshivtechem vehaya hashshevet asher-yilkedennu Adonai yikrav lammishpachot vehammishpacha asher-yilkedenna Adonai tikrav labbattim vehabbayit asher yilkedennu Adonai yikrav laggevarim
Vehaya hannilkad bacherem yissaref baesh oto veet-kal-asher-lo ki avar et-berit Adonai vechi-asa nevala beyisrael
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyakrev et-yisrael lishvatav vayyillached shevet yehuda
Vayyakrev et-mishpachat yehuda vayyilkod et mishpachat hazzarchi vayyakrev et-mishpachat hazzarchi laggevarim vayyillached zavdi
Vayyakrev et-beto laggevarim vayyillached achan ben-karmi ven-zavdi ben-zerach lematte yehuda
Vayyomer yehoshua el-achan beni sim-na chavod la-Adonai elohe yisrael veten-lo toda vehagged-na li me asita al-techached mimmenni
Vayyaan achan et-yehoshua vayyomar amna anochi chatati la-Adonai elohe yisrael vechazot vechazot asiti
Vaere vashshalal adderet shinar achat tova umatayim shekalim kesef ulshon zahav echad chamishshim shekalim mishkalo vaechmedem vaekkachem vehinnam temunim baaretz betoch haaholi vehakkesef tachteha
Vayyishlach yehoshua malachim vayyarutzu haohela vehinne temuna beaholo vehakkesef tachteha
Vayyikkachum mittoch haohel vayevium el-yehoshua veel kal-bene yisrael vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai

Vayyikkach yehoshua et-achan ben-zerach veet-hakkesef veet-haadderet veet-leshon hazzahav veet-banav veet-benotav veet-shoro veet-chamoro veet-tzono veet-aholo veet-kal-asher-lo vechal-yisrael immo vayyaalu otam emek achor
Vayyomer yehoshua me achartanu yakorcha Adonai bayyom hazze vayyirgemu oto chal-yisrael even vayyisrefu otam baesh vayyiskelu otam baavanim
Vayyakimu alav gal-avanim gadol ad hayyom hazze vayyashav Adonai mecharon appo al-ken kara shem hammakom hahu emek achor ad hayyom hazze
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua al-tira veal-techat kach immecha et kal-am hammilchama vekum ale haa ree natatti veyadcha et-melech haa veet-ammo veet-iro veet-artzo
Veasita laa ulmalkah kaasher asita liricho ulmalkah rak-shelalah uvhemtah tavozzu lachem sim-lecha orev lair meachareha
Vayyakam yehoshua vechal-am hammilchama laalot haa vayyivchar yehoshua sheloshim elef ish gibbore hachayil vayyishlachem layela
Vayetzav otam lemor reu attem orvim lair meachare hair al-tarchiku min-hair meod vihyitem kullechem nechonim
Vaani vechal-haam asher itti nikrav el-hair vehaya ki-yetzu likratenu kaasher barishona venasnu lifnehem
Veyatzu acharenu ad hattikenu otam min-hair ki yomru nasim lefanenu kaasher barishona venasnu lifnehem
Veattem takumu mehaorev vehorashtem et-hair untanah Adonai elohechem beyedchem
Vehaya ketafsechem et-hair tatztzitu et-hair baesh kidvar Adonai taasu reu tziviti etchem
Vayyishlachem yehoshua vayyelchu el-hammarav vayyeshvu ben bet-el uven haa miyyam laa vayyalen yehoshua ballayela hahu betoch haam
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyifkod et-haam vayyaal hu vezikne yisrael lifne haam haa
Vechal-haam hammilchama asher itto alu vayyiggeshu vayyavou neged hair vayyachanu mitztzefon laa vehagga benav uven-haa
Vayyikkach kachameshet alafim ish vayyasem otam orev ben bet-el uven haa miyyam lair
Vayyasimu haam et-kal-hammachane asher mitztzefon lair veet-akevo miyyam lair vayyelech yehoshua ballayela hahu betoch haemek
Vayehi kirot melech-haa vayemaharu vayyashkimu vayyetzu anshe-hair likrat-yisrael lammilchama hu vechal-ammo lammoed lifne haarava vehu lo yada ki-orev lo meachare hair
Vayyinnagu yehoshua vechal-yisrael lifnehem vayyanusu derech hammidbar
Vayyizzaaku kal-haam asher baa lirdof acharehem vayyirdefu achare yehoshua vayyinnatku min-hair
Velo-nishar ish baa uvet el asher lo-yatzu achare yisrael vayyaazvu et-hair petucha vayyirdefu achare yisrael
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua nete bakkidon asher-beyadcha el-haa ki veyadcha ettenenna vayyet yehoshua bakkidon asher-beyado el-hair
Vehaorev kam mehera mimmekomo vayyarutzu kintot yado vayyavou hair vayyilkeduha vayemaharu vayyatztzitu et-hair baesh
Vayyifnu anshe haa acharehem vayyiru vehinne ala ashan hair hashshamayema velo-haya vahem yadayim lanus henna vahenna vehaam hannas hammidbar nehpach el-harodef
Vihoshua vechal-yisrael rau ki-lachad haorev et-hair vechi ala ashan hair vayyashuvu vayyakku et-anshe haa
Veelle yatzu min-hair likratam vayyihyu leyisrael battavech elle mizze veelle mizze vayyakku otam ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid ufalit
Veet-melech haa tafsu cha vayyakrivu oto el-yehoshua
Vayehi kechallot yisrael laharog et-kal-yoshve haa bassade bammidbar asher redafum bo vayyippelu chullam lefi-cherev ad-tummam vayyashuvu chal-yisrael haa vayyakku otah lefi-charev
Vayehi chal-hannoflim bayyom hahu meish vead-ishsha shenem asar alef kol anshe haa
Vihoshua lo-heshiv yado asher nata bakkidon ad asher hecherim et kal-yoshve haa
Rak habbehema ushlal hair hahi bazzu lahem yisrael kidvar Adonai asher tziva et-yehoshua
Vayyisrof yehoshua et-haa vayesimeha tel-olam shemama ad hayyom hazze
Veet-melech haa tala al-haetz ad-et haarev uchvo hashshemesh tziva yehoshua vayyoridu et-nivlato min-haetz vayyashlichu otah el-petach shaar hair vayyakimu alav gal-avanim gadol ad hayyom hazze
Az yivne yehoshua mizbeach la-Adonai elohe yisrael behar eval
Kaasher tziva moshe eved-Adonai et-bene yisrael kakkatuv besefer torat moshe mizbach avanim shelemot asher lo-henif alehen barzel vayyaalu alav olot la-Adonai vayyizbechu shelamim
Vayyichtav-sham al-haavanim et mishne torat moshe asher katav lifne bene yisrael

Vechal-yisrael uzkenav veshotrim veshoftav omdim mizze umizze laaron neged hakkohanim halviyyim nose aron berit-Adonai kagger kaezrach chetzyo el-mul har-gerizim vehachetzyo el-mul har-eval kaasher tziva moshe eved-Adonai levarech et-haam yisrael barishona
Veachare-chen kara et-kal-divre hattora habberacha vehakkelala kechal-hakkatuv besefer hattora
Lo-haya davar mikkol asher-tziva moshe asher lo-kara yehoshua neged kal-kehal yisrael vehannashim vehattaf vehagger haholech bekirbam
Vayehi chishmoa kal-hammelachim asher beever hayyarden bahar uvashshefela uvchol chof hayyam haggadol el-mul hallevanon hachitti vehaemori hakkenaani happerizzi hachivi vehayevusi
Vayyitkabbetzu yachdav lehillachem im-yehoshua veim-yisrael pe echad
Veyoshve givon shamu et asher asa yehoshua liricho velaa
Vayyaasu gam-hemma bearma vayyelchu vayyitztayyaru vayyikchu sakkim balim lachamorehem venodot yayin balim umvukkaim umtzorarim
Unalot balot umtullaot beraglehem uslamot balot alehem vechol lechem tzedam yavesh haya nikkudim
Vayyelchu el-yehoshua el-hammachane haggilgal vayyomru elav veel-ish yisrael meeretz rechoka banu veatta kirtu-lanu verit
Vayyomer ish-yisrael el-hachivi ula bekirbi atta yoshev veech chrt-echrat- lecha verit
Vayyomru el-yehoshua avadecha anachnu vayyomer alehem yehoshua mi attem umeayin tavou
Vayyomru elav meeretz rechoka meod bau avadecha leshem Adonai elohecha ki-shamanu shamo veet kal-asher asa bemitzrayim
Veet kal-asher asa lishne malche haemori asher beever hayyarden lesichon melech cheshbon ulog melech-habbashan asher beashtarot
Vayyomru elenu zekenenu vechal-yoshve artzenu lemor kechu veyedchem tzeda ladderech ulchu likratam vaamartem alehem avdechem anachnu veatta kirtu-lanu verit
Ze lachmenu cham hitztayyadnu oto mibbattenu beom tzetenu lalechet alechem veatta hinne yavesh vehaya nikkudim
Veelle nodot hayyayin asher millenu chadashim vehinne hitbakkau veelle salmotenu unalenu balu merov hadderech meod
Vayyikchu haanashim mitztzedam veet-pi Adonai lo shaalu
Vayyaas lahem yehoshua shalom vayyichrot lahem berit lechayyotam vayyishshavu lahem nesie haeda
Vayehi miktze sheloshet yamim achare asher-kartu lahem berit vayyishmeu ki-kerovim hem elav uvkirbo hem yoshvim
Vayyisu vene-yisrael vayyavou el-arehem bayyom hashshelishi vearehem givon vehakkefira uverot vekiryat yearim
Velo hikkum bene yisrael ki-nishbeu lahem nesie haeda ba-Adonai elohe yisrael vayyillonu chal-haeda al-hannesiim
Vayyomru chal-hannesiim el-kal-haeda anachnu nishbanu lahem ba-Adonai elohe yisrael veatta lo nuchal lingoa bahem
Zot naase lahem vehachaye otam velo-yihye alenu ketzef al-hashshevua asher-nishbanu lahem
Vayyomru alehem hannesiim yichyu vayyihyu chotve etzim veshoave-mayim lechal-haeda kaasher dibberu lahem hannesiim
Vayyikra lahem yehoshua vayedabber alehem lemor lamma rimmitem otanu lemor rechokim anachnu mikkem meod veattem bekirbenu yoshvim
Veatta arurim attem velo-yikkaret mikkem eved vechotve etzim veshoave-mayim levet eloha

Vayyaanu et-yehoshua vayyomru ki hugged huggad laavadecha et asher tziva Adonai elohecha et-moshe avdo latet lachem et-kal-haaretz ulhashmid et-kal-yoshve haaretz mippenechem vannira meod lenafshotenu mippenechem vannaase et-haddavar hazze
Veatta hinnu veyadecha kattov vechayyashar beenecha laasot lanu ase
Vayyaas lahem ken vayyatztzel otam miyyad bene-yisrael velo haragum
Vayyittenem yehoshua bayyom hahu chotve etzim veshoave mayim laeda ulmizbach Adonai ad-hayyom hazze el-hammakom asher yivchar
Vayehi chishmoa adoni-tzedek melech yerushalam ki-lachad yehoshua et-haa vayyacharimah kaasher asa liricho ulmalkah ken-asa laa ulmalkah vechi hishlimu yoshve givon et-yisrael vayyihyu bekirbam
Vayyiru meod ki ir gedola givon keachat are hammamlacha vechi hi gedola min-haa vechal-anasheha gibborim
Vayyishlach adoni-tzedek melech yerushalam el-hoham melech-chevron veel-piram melech-yarmut veel-yafia melech-lachish veel-devir melech-eglon lemor
Alu-ela veizruni venakke et-givon ki-hishlima et-yehoshua veet-bene yisrael
Vayyeasfu vayyaalu chameshet malche haemori melech yerushalam melech-chevron melech-yarmut melech-lachish melech-eglon hem vechal-machanehem vayyachanu al-givon vayyillachamu aleha
Vayyishlechu anshe givon el-yehoshua el-hammachane haggilgala lemor al-teref yadecha meavadecha ale elenu mehera vehoshia lanu veazrenu ki nikbetzu elenu kal-malche haemori yoshve hahar
Vayyaal yehoshua min-haggilgal hu vechal-am hammilchama immo vechol gibbore hechayil
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua al-tira mehem ki veyadcha netattim lo-yaamod ish mehem befanecha
Vayyavo alehem yehoshua pitom kal-hallayela ala min-haggilgal
Vayehummem Adonai lifne yisrael vayyakkem makka-gedola begivon vayyirdefem derech maale vet-choron vayyakkem ad-azeka vead-makkeda

Vayehi benusam mippene yisrael hem bemorad bet-choron va-Adonai hishlich alehem avanim gedolot min-hashshamayim ad-azeka vayyamutu rabbim asher-metu beavne habbarad measher hargu bene yisrael becharev

Vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad ad-yikkom goy oyevav halo-hi chetuva al-sefer hayyashar vayyaamod hashshemesh bachatzi hashshamayim velo-atz lavo keom tamim
Velo haya kayyom hahu lefanav veacharav lishmoa Adonai bekol ish ki Adonai nilcham leyisrael
Vayyashav yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo el-hammachane haggilgala
Vayyanusu chameshet hammelachim haelle vayyechavu vammeara bemakkeda
Vayyuggad lihoshua lemor nimtzeu chameshet hammelachim nechbeim bammeara bemakkeda
Vayyomer yehoshua gollu avanim gedolot el-pi hammeara vehafkidu aleha anashim leshamram
Veattem al-taamodu ridfu achare oyevechem vezinnavtem otam al-tittenum lavo el-arehem ki netanam Adonai elohechem beyedchem
Vayehi kechallot yehoshua uvne yisrael lehakkotam makka gedola-meod ad-tummam vehasseridim sardu mehem vayyavou el-are hammivtzar
Vayyashuvu chal-haam el-hammachane el-yehoshua makkeda beshalom lo-charatz livne yisrael leish et-leshono
Vayyomer yehoshua pitchu et-pi hammeara vehotziu ela et-chameshet hammelachim haelle min-hammeara
Vayyaasu chen vayyotziu elav et-chameshet hammelachim haelle min-hammeara et melech yerushalam et-melech chevron et-melech yarmut et-melech lachish et-melech eglon

Vayehi kehotziam et-hammelachim haelle el-yehoshua vayyikra yehoshua el-kal-ish yisrael vayyomer el-ketzine anshe hammilchama hehalchu itto kirvu simu et-raglechem al-tzavvere hammelachim haelle vayyikrevu vayyasimu et-raglehem al-tzavverehem
Vayyomer alehem yehoshua al-tiru veal-techattu chizku veimtzu ki chacha yaase Adonai lechal-oyevechem asher attem nilchamim otam
Vayyakkem yehoshua achare-chen vayemitem vayyitlem al chamishsha etzim vayyihyu teluyim al-haetzim ad-haarev
Vayehi leet bo hashshemesh tziva yehoshua vayyoridum meal haetzim vayyashlichum el-hammeara asher nechbeu-sham vayyasimu avanim gedolot al-pi hammeara ad-etzem hayyom hazze
Veet-makkeda lachad yehoshua bayyom hahu vayyakkeha lefi-cherev veet-malkah hecherim otam veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lo hishir sarid vayyaas lemelech makkeda kaasher asa lemelech yericho
Vayyaavor yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo mimmakkeda livna vayyillachem im-livna
Vayyitten Adonai gam-otah beyad yisrael veet-malkah vayyakkeha lefi-cherev veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lo-hishir bah sarid vayyaas lemalkah kaasher asa lemelech yericho
Vayyaavor yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo millivna lachisha vayyichan aleha vayyillachem bah
Vayyitten Adonai et-lachish beyad yisrael vayyilkedah bayyom hashsheni vayyakkeha lefi-cherev veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah kechol asher-asa lelivna
Az ala horam melech gezer lazor et-lachish vayyakkehu yehoshua veet-ammo ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid
Vayyaavor yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo millachish eglona vayyachanu aleha vayyillachamu aleha
Vayyilkeduha bayyom hahu vayyakkuha lefi-cherev veet kal-hannefesh asher-bah bayyom hahu hecherim kechol asher-asa lelachish
Vayyaal yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo meeglona chevrona vayyillachamu aleha
Vayyilkeduha vayyakkuha-lefi-cherev veet-malkah veet-kal-areha veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lo-hishir sarid kechol asher-asa leeglon vayyacharem otah veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah

Vayyakke yehoshua et-kal-haaretz hahar vehannegev vehashshefela vehaashedot veet kal-malchehem lo hishir sarid veet kal-hanneshama hecherim kaasher tziva Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyakkem yehoshua mikkadesh barnea vead-azza veet kal-eretz goshen vead-givon
Veet kal-hammelachim haelle veet-artzam lachad yehoshua paam echat ki Adonai elohe yisrael nilcham leyisrael
Vayyashav yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo el-hammachane haggilgala
Vayehi kishmoa yavin melech-chatzor vayyishlach el-yovav melech madon veel-melech shimron veel-melech achshaf
Veel-hammelachim asher mitztzefon bahar uvaarava negev kinarot uvashshefela uvnafot dor miyyam
Hakkenaani mimmizrach umiyyam vehaemori vehachitti vehapperizzi vehayevusi bahar vehachivi tachat chermon beeretz hammitzpa
Vayyetzu hem vechal-machanehem immam am-rav kachol asher al-sefat-hayyam larov vesus varechev rav-meod
Vayyivaadu kol hammelachim haelle vayyavou vayyachanu yachdav el-me merom lehillachem im-yisrael
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua al-tira mippenehem ki-machar kaet hazzot anochi noten et-kullam chalalim lifne yisrael et-susehem teakker veet-markevotehem tisrof baesh
Vayyavo yehoshua vechal-am hammilchama immo alehem al-me merom pitom vayyippelu bahem
Vayyittenem Adonai beyad-yisrael vayyakkum vayyirdefum ad-tzidon rabba vead misrefot mayim vead-bikat mitzpe mizracha vayyakkum ad-bilti hishir-lahem sarid
Vayyaas lahem yehoshua kaasher amar-lo Adonai et-susehem ikker veet-markevotehem saraf baesh
Vayyashav yehoshua baet hahi vayyilkod et-chatzor veet-malkah hikka vecharev ki-chatzor lefanim hi rosh kal-hammamlachot haelle
Vayyakku et-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lefi-cherev hacharem lo notar kal-neshama veet-chatzor saraf baesh
Veet-kal-are hammelachim-haelle veet-kal-malchehem lachad yehoshua vayyakkem lefi-cherev hecherim otam kaasher tziva moshe eved Adonai
Rak kal-hearim haomdot al-tillam lo serafam yisrael zulati et-chatzor levaddah saraf yehoshua
Vechol shelal hearim haelle vehabbehema bazzu lahem bene yisrael rak et-kal-haadam hikku lefi-cherev ad-hishmidam otam lo hishiru kal-neshama
Kaasher tziva Adonai et-moshe avdo ken-tziva moshe et-yehoshua vechen asa yehoshua lo-hesir davar mikkol asher-tziva Adonai et-moshe
Vayyikkach yehoshua et-kal-haaretz hazzot hahar veet-kal-hannegev veet kal-eretz haggoshen veet-hashshefela veet-haarava veet-har yisrael ushfelato
Min-hahar hechalak haole seir vead-baal gad bevikat hallevanon tachat har-chermon veet kal-malchehem lachad vayyakkem vayemitem
Yamim rabbim asa yehoshua et-kal-hammelachim haelle milchama
Lo-hayeta ir asher hishlima el-bene yisrael bilti hachivi yoshve givon et-hakkol lakchu vammilchama
Ki meet Adonai hayeta lechazzek et-libbam likrat hammilchama et-yisrael lemaan hacharimam levilti heot-lahem techinna ki lemaan hashmidam kaasher tziva Adonai et-moshe
Vayyavo yehoshua baet hahi vayyachret et-haanakim min-hahar min-chevron min-devir min-anav umikkol har yehuda umikkol har yisrael im-arehem hecherimam yehoshua
Lo-notar anakim beeretz bene yisrael rak beazza begat uvashdod nisharu
Vayyikkach yehoshua et-kal-haaretz kechol asher dibber Adonai el-moshe vayyittenah yehoshua lenachala leyisrael kemachlekotam leshivtehem vehaaretz shakta mimmilchama
Veelle malche haaretz asher hikku vene-yisrael vayyirshu et-artzam beever hayyarden mizrecha hashshamesh minnachal arnon ad-har chermon vechal-haarava mizracha
Sichon melech haemori hayyoshev becheshbon moshel mearoer asher al-sefat-nachal arnon vetoch hannachal vachatzi haggilad vead yabbok hannachal gevul bene ammon

Kal-yoshve hahar min-hallevanon ad-misrefot mayim kal-tzidonim anochi orishem mippene bene yisrael rak happileha leyisrael benachala kaasher tziviticha
Veatta challek et-haaretz hazzot benachala letishat hashshevatim vachatzi hashshevet hamnashshe

Kal-mamlechut og babbashan asher-malach beashtarot uvedrei hu nishar miyyeter harfaim vayyakkem moshe vayyorishem

Rak leshevet hallevi lo natan nachala ishshe Adonai elohe yisrael hu nachalato kaasher dibber-lo
Vayyitten moshe lematte vene-reuven lemishpechotam

Velo-yasaf od malach Adonai leherao el-manoach veel-ishto az yada manoach ki-malach Adonai hu
Vayyomer manoach el-ishto mot namut ki elohim rainu
Vattomer lo ishto lu chafetz Adonai lahamitenu lo-lakach miyyadenu ola umincha velo heranu et-kal-elle vechaet lo hishmianu kazot
Vatteled haishsha ben vattikra et-shemo shimshon vayyigdal hannaar vayevarchehu Adonai
Vattachel ruach Adonai lefaamo bemachane-dan ben tzara uven eshtaol
Vayyered shimshon timnata vayyar ishsha betimnata mibbenot pelishtim
Vayyaal vayyagged leaviv ulimmo vayyomer ishsha raiti vetimnata mibbenot pelishtim veatta kechu-otah li leishsha
Vayyomer lo aviv veimmo haen bivnot achecha uvchal-ammi ishsha ki-atta holech lakachat ishsha mippelishtim haarelim vayyomer shimshon el-aviv otah kach-li ki-hi yashra veena
Veaviv veimmo lo yadu ki me-Adonai hi ki-toana hu-mevakkesh mippelishtim uvaet hahi pelishtim moshlim beyisrael
Vayyered shimshon veaviv veimmo timnata vayyavou ad-karme timnata vehinne kefir araot shoeg likrato
Vattitzlach alav ruach Adonai vayeshasseehu keshassa haggedi umuma en beyado velo higgid leaviv ulimmo et asher asa
Vayyered vayedabber laishsha vattishar beene shimshon
Vayyashav miyyamim lekachtah vayyasar lirot et mappelet haarye vehinne adat devorim bigviyyat haarye udvash
Vayyirdehu el-kappav vayyelech haloch veachol vayyelech el-aviv veel-immo vayyitten lahem vayyochelu velo-higgid lahem ki miggeviyyat haarye rada haddevash
Vayyered avihu el-haishsha vayyaas sham shimshon mishte ki ken yaasu habbachurim
Vayehi kirotam oto vayyikchu sheloshim mereim vayyihyu itto
Vayyomer lahem shimshon achuda-na lachem chida im-hagged taggidu otah li shivat yeme hammishte umtzatem venatatti lachem sheloshim sedinim ushloshim chalifot begadim
Veim-lo tuchlu lehaggid li untattem attem li sheloshim sedinim ushloshim chalifot begadim vayyomru lo chuda chidatcha venishmaenna
Vayyomer lahem mehaochel yatza maachal umeaz yatza matok velo yachlu lehaggid hachida sheloshet yamim
Vayehi bayyom hashshevii vayyomru leeshet-shimshon patti et-ishech veyagged-lanu et-hachida pen-nisrof otach veet-bet avich baesh halyarshenu keratem lanu halo
Vattevke eshet shimshon alav vattomer rak-senetani velo ahavtani hachida chadta livne ammi veli lo higgadta vayyomer lah hinne leavi ulimmi lo higgadti velach aggid
Vattevke alav shivat hayyamim asher-haya lahem hammishte vayehi bayyom hashshevii vayyagged-lah ki hetzikathu vattagged hachida livne ammah
Vayyomru lo anshe hair bayyom hashshevii beterem yavo hacharsa ma-matok middevash ume az meari vayyomer lahem lule charashtem beeglati lo metzatem chidati
Vattitzlach alav ruach Adonai vayyered ashkelon vayyach mehem sheloshim ish vayyikkach et-chalitzotam vayyitten hachalifot lemaggide hachida vayyichar appo vayyaal bet avihu
Vattehi eshet shimshon lemereehu asher rea lo
Vayehi miyyamim bime ketzir-chittim vayyifkod shimshon et-ishto bigdi izzim vayyomer avoa el-ishti hechadra velo-netano aviha lavo
Vayyomer aviha amor amarti ki-sano senetah vaettenenna lemereecha halo achotah hakketanna tova mimmenna tehi-na lecha tachteha
Vayyomer lahem shimshon nikketi happaam mippelishtim ki-ose ani immam raa
Vayyelech shimshon vayyilkod shelosh-meot shualim vayyikkach lappidim vayyefen zanav el-zanav vayyasem lappid echad ben-shene hazzenavot battavech
Vayyaver-esh ballappidim vayeshallach bekamot pelishtim vayyaver miggadish vead-kama vead-kerem zayit
Vayyomru felishtim mi asa zot vayyomru shimshon chatan hattimni ki lakach et-ishto vayyittenah lemereehu vayyaalu felishtim vayyisrefu otah veet-aviha baesh
Vayyomer lahem shimshon im-taasun kazot ki im-nikkamti vachem veachar echdal
Vayyach otam shok al-yarech makka gedola vayyered vayyeshev bisif sela etam
Vayyaalu felishtim vayyachanu bihuda vayyinnatshu ballechi
Vayyomru ish yehuda lama alitem alenu vayyomru leesor et-shimshon alinu laasot lo kaasher asa lanu
Vayyerdu sheloshet alafim ish mihuda el-seif sela etam vayyomru leshimshon halo yadata ki-moshlim banu pelishtim uma-zot asita lanu vayyomer lahem kaasher asu li ken asiti lahem
Vayyomru lo leesarcha yaradnu letittecha beyad-pelishtim vayyomer lahem shimshon hishshavu li pen-tifgeun bi attem
Vayyomru lo lemor lo ki-asor neesarcha untannucha veyadam vehamet lo nemitecha vayyaasruhu bishnayim avotim chadashim vayyaaluhu min-hassala
Hu-va ad-lechi uflishittim heriu likrato vattitzlach alav ruach Adonai vattihyena haavotim asher al-zerootav kappishtim asher baaru vaesh vayyimmassu esurav meal yadav
Vayyimtza lechi-chamor teriyya vayyishlach yado vayyikkacheha vayyach-bah elef ish
Vayyomer shimshon bilchi hachamor chamor chamoratayim bilchi hachamor hikketi elef ish
Vayehi kechalloto ledabber vayyashlech hallechi miyyado vayyikra lammakom hahu ramat lechi
Vayyitzma meod vayyikra el-Adonai vayyomar atta natatta veyad-avdecha et-hatteshua haggedola hazzot veatta amut batztzama venafalti beyad haarelim
Vayyivka elohim et-hammachtesh asher-ballechi vayyetzu mimmennu mayim vayyeshte vattashav rucho vayyechi al-ken kara shemah en hakkore asher ballechi ad hayyom hazze
Vayyishpot et-yisrael bime felishtim esrim shana
Vayyelech shimshon azzata vayyar-sham ishsha zona vayyavo eleha
Laazzatim lemor ba shimshon henna vayyasobbu vayyeervu-lo chal-hallayela beshaar hair vayyitcharshu chal-hallayela lemor ad-or habboker vahargenuhu

Vayyishkav shimshon ad-chatzi hallayela vayyakam bachatzi hallayela vayyeechoz bedaltot shaar-hair uvishte hammezuzot vayyissaem im-habberiach vayyasem al-ketefav vayyaalem el-rosh hahar asher al-pene chevron
Vayehi achare-chen vayyeehav ishsha benachal sorek ushmah delila
Vayyaalu eleha sarne felishtim vayyomru lah patti oto uri bamme kocho gadol uvamme nuchal lo vaasarnuhu leannoto vaanachnu nittan-lach ish elef umea kasef
Vattomer delila el-shimshon haggida-na li bamme kochacha gadol uvamme teaser leannotecha
Vayyomer eleha shimshon im-yaasruni beshiva yetarim lachim asher lo-choravu vechaliti vehayiti keachad haadam
Vayyaalu-lah sarne felishtim shiva yetarim lachim asher lo-choravu vattaasrehu bahem
Vehaorev yoshev lah bacheder vattomer elav pelishtim alecha shimshon vayenattek et-hayetarim kaasher yinnatek petil-hanneoret baharicho esh velo noda kocho
Vattomer delila el-shimshon hinne hetalta bi vattedabber ela kezavim atta haggida-na li bamme teaser
Vayyomer eleha im-asor yaasruni baavotim chadashim asher lo-naasa vahem melacha vechaliti vehayiti keachad haadam
Vattikkach delila avotim chadashim vattaasrehu vahem vattomer elav pelishtim alecha shimshon vehaorev yoshev bechader vayenattekem meal zerootav kachut
Vattomer delila el-shimshon ad-henna hetalta bi vattedabber ela kezavim haggida li bamme teaser vayyomer eleha im-taargi et-sheva machlefot roshi im-hammassachet
Vattitka bayyated vattomer elav pelishtim alecha shimshon vayyikatz mishshenato vayyissa et-hayetad haereg veet-hammassachet
Vattomer elav ech tomar ahavtich velibbecha en itti ze shalosh peamim hetalta bi velo-higgadta li bamme kochacha gadol
Vayehi ki-hetzika lo vidvareha kal-hayyamim vattealatzehu vattiktzar nafsho lamut
Vayyagged-lah et-kal-libbo vayyomer lah mora lo-ala al-roshi ki-nezir elohim ani mibbeten immi im-gullachti vesar mimmenni chochi vechaliti vehayiti kechal-haadam
Vattere delila ki-higgid lah et-kal-libbo vattishlach vattikra lesarne felishtim lemor alu happaam ki-higgid li et-kal-libbo vealu eleha sarne felishtim vayyaalu hakkesef beyadam
Vatteyashshenehu al-birkeha vattikra laish vattegallach et-sheva machlefot rosho vattachel leannoto vayyasar kocho mealav
Vattomer pelishtim alecha shimshon vayyikatz mishshenato vayyomer etze kefaam befaam veinnaer vehu lo yada ki Adonai sar mealav
Vayyochazuhu felishtim vayenakkeru et-enav vayyoridu oto azzata vayyaasruhu banchushtayim vayehi tochen bevet haasurim
Vayyachel sear-rosho letzammeach kaasher gullach
Vesarne felishtim neesfu lizboach zevach-gadol ledagon elohehem ulsimcha vayyomru natan elohenu beyadenu et shimshon oyevenu
Vayyiru oto haam vayehallu et-elohehem ki amru natan elohenu veyadenu et-oyevenu veet machariv artzenu vaasher hirba et-chalalenu
Vayehi chy ketov libbam vayyomru kiru leshimshon visachek-lanu vayyikreu leshimshon mibbet haasurim vayetzachek lifnehem vayyaamidu oto ben haammudim
Vayyomer shimshon el-hannaar hammachazik beyado hannicha oti vahamisheni et-haammudim asher habbayit nachon alehem veeshshaen alehem
Vehabbayit male haanashim vehannashim veshamma kol sarne felishtim veal-haggag kishloshet alafim ish veishsha haroim bischok shimshon
Vayyikra shimshon el-Adonai vayyomar adona Adonai zachreni na vechazzekeni na ach happaam hazze haelohim veinnakma nekam-achat mishshete ena mippelishtim
Vayyilpot shimshon et-shene ammude hattavech asher habbayit nachon alehem vayyissamech alehem echad bimino veechad bismolo
Vayyomer shimshon tamot nafshi im-pelishtim vayyet bechoach vayyippol habbayit al-hasseranim veal-kal-haam asher-bo vayyihyu hammetim asher hemit bemoto rabbim measher hemit bechayyav
Vayyerdu echav vechal-bet avihu vayyisu oto vayyaalu vayyikberu oto ben tzara uven eshtaol bekever manoach aviv vehu shafat et-yisrael esrim shana
Vayehi-ish mehar-efrayim ushmo michayehu
Vayyomer leimmo elef umea hakkesef asher lukkach-lach veatte alit vegam amarte beazna hinne-hakkesef itti ani lekachtiv vattomer immo baruch beni la-Adonai
Vayyashev et-elef-umea hakkesef leimmo vattomer immo hakdesh hikdashti et-hakkesef la-Adonai miyyadi livni laasot pesel umassecha veatta ashivennu lach

Vayehi-naar mibbet lechem yehuda mimmishpachat yehuda vehu levi vehu gar-sham
Vayyelech haish mehair mibbet lechem yehuda lagur baasher yimtza vayyavo har-efrayim ad-bet micha laasot darko
Vayyomer-lo micha meayin tavo vayyomer elav levi anochi mibbet lechem yehuda veanochi holech lagur baasher emtza
Vayyomer lo micha sheva immadi vehye-li leav ulchohen veanochi etten-lecha aseret kesef layyamim veerech begadim umichyatecha vayyelech hallevi
Vayyoel hallevi lashevet et-haish vayehi hannaar lo keachad mibbanav

Bayyamim hahem en melech beyisrael uvayyamim hahem shevet haddani mevakkesh-lo nachala lashevet ki lo-nafla lo ad-hayyom hahu betoch-shivte yisrael benachala

Vayyomru lo hacharesh sim-yadcha al-picha velech immanu vehye-lanu leav ulchohen hatov heotcha chohen levet ish echad o heotcha chohen leshevet ulmishpacha beyisrael
Vayyitav lev hakkohen vayyikkach et-haefod veet-hatterafim veet-happasel vayyavo bekerev haam
Vayyifnu vayyelechu vayyasimu et-hattaf veet-hammikne veet-hakkevudda lifnehem
Hemma hirchiku mibbet micha vehaanashim asher babbattim asher im-bet micha nizaku vayyadbiku et-bene-dan
Vayyikreu el-bene-dan vayyassebbu penehem vayyomru lemicha ma-lecha ki nizakta
Vayyomer et-eloha asher-asiti lekachtem veet-hakkohen vattelchu uma-li od uma-ze tomru ela ma-lach
Vayyomru elav bene-dan al-tashma kolcha immanu pen-yifgeu vachem anashim mare nefesh veasafta nafshecha venefesh betecha
Vayyelchu vene-dan ledarkam vayyar micha ki-chazakim hemma mimmennu vayyifen vayyashav el-beto
Vehemma lakchu et asher-asa micha veet-hakkohen asher haya-lo vayyavou al-layish al-am shoket uvoteach vayyakku otam lefi-charev veet-hair sarfu vaesh
Veen matztzil ki rechoka-hi mitztzidon vedavar en-lahem im-adam vehi baemek asher levet-rechov vayyivnu et-hair vayyeshvu vah
Vayyikreu shem-hair dan beshem dan avihem asher yullad leyisrael veulam layish shem-hair larishona
Vayyakimu lahem bene-dan et-happasel vihonatan ben-gershom ben-menashshe hu uvanav hau chohanim leshevet haddani ad-yom gelot haaretz
Vayyasimu lahem et-pesel micha asher asa kal-yeme heot bet-haelohim beshilo
Vayehi bayyamim hahem umelech en beyisrael vayehi ish levi gar beyarkete har-efrayim vayyikkach-lo ishsha filegesh mibbet lechem yehuda
Vattizne alav pilagsho vattelech meitto el-bet aviha el-bet lechem yehuda vattehi-sham yamim arbaa chodashim
Vayyakam ishah vayyelech achareha ledabber al-libbah lahashivah venaaro immo vetzemed chamorim vatteviehu bet aviha vayyirehu avi hannaara vayyismach likrato
Vayyechezak-bo chotno avi hannaara vayyeshev itto sheloshet yamim vayyochlu vayyishtu vayyalinu sham
Vayehi bayyom harvii vayyashkimu vabboker vayyakam lalechet vayyomer avi hannaara el-chatano sead libbecha pat-lechem veachar telechu
Vayyeshvu vayyochlu shenehem yachdav vayyishtu vayyomer avi hannaara el-haish hoel-na velin veyitav libbecha
Vayyakam haish lalechet vayyiftzar-bo chotno vayyashav vayyalen sham
Vayyashkem babboker bayyom hachamishi lalechet vayyomer avi hannaara sead-na levavcha vehitmahmehu ad-netot hayyom vayyochlu shenehem

Vayyakam haish lalechet hu ufilagsho venaaro vayyomer lo chotno avi hannaara hinne na rafa hayyom laarov linu-na hinne chanot hayyom lin po veyitav levavecha vehishkamtem machar ledarkechem vehalachta leohalecha
Velo-ava haish lalun vayyakam vayyelech vayyavo ad-nochach yevus hi yerushalam veimmo tzemed chamorim chavushim ufilagsho immo
Hem im-yevus vehayyom rad meod vayyomer hannaar el-adonav lecha-na venasura el-ir-hayevusi hazzot venalin bah
Vayyomer elav adonav lo nasur el-ir nachri asher lo-mibbene yisrael henna veavarnu ad-giva
Vayyomer lenaaro lecha venikreva beachad hammekomot velannu vaggiva o varama
Vayyaavru vayyelechu vattavo lahem hashshemesh etzel haggiva asher levinyamin
Vayyasuru sham lavo lalun baggiva vayyavo vayyeshev birchov hair veen ish meassef-otam habbayeta lalun
Vehinne ish zaken ba min-maasehu min-hassade baerev vehaish mehar efrayim vehu-gar baggiva veanshe hammakom bene yemini
Vayyissa enav vayyar et-haish haoreach birchov hair vayyomer haish hazzaken ana telech umeayin tavo
Vayyomer elav ovrim anachnu mibbet-lechem yehuda ad-yarkete har-efrayim mishsham anochi vaelech ad-bet lechem yehuda veet-bet Adonai ani holech veen ish meassef oti habbayeta
Vegam-teven gam-mispo yesh lachamorenu vegam lechem vayayin yesh-li velaamatecha velannaar im-avadecha en machsor kal-davar
Vayyomer haish hazzaken shalom lach rak kal-machsorcha ala rak barchov al-talan
Vayeviehu leveto vayyaval lachamorim vayyirchatzu raglehem vayyochlu vayyishtu

Vayyetze alehem haish baal habbayit vayyomer alehem al-acha al-tareu na achare asher-ba haish hazze al-beti al-taasu et-hannevala hazzot

Velo-avu haanashim lishmoa lo vayyachazek haish befilagsho vayyotze alehem hachutz vayyedu otah vayyitallelu-vah kal-hallayela ad-habboker vayeshallechuha kaalot hashshachar
Vattavo haishsha lifnot habboker vattippol petach bet-haish asher-adoneha sham ad-haor
Vayyakam adoneha babboker vayyiftach daltot habbayit vayyetze lalechet ledarko vehinne haishsha filagsho nofelet petach habbayit veyadeha al-hassaf

Vehaya chal-haroe veamar lo-nihyeta velo-nirata kazot lemiyyom alot bene-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim ad hayyom hazze simu-lachem aleha utzu vedabberu
Vayyetzu kal-bene yisrael vattikkahel haeda keish echad lemiddan vead-beer sheva veeretz haggilad el-Adonai hammitzpa
Vayyityatztzevu pinnot kal-haam kol shivte yisrael bikhal am haelohim arba meot elef ish ragli sholef charev
Vayyishmeu bene vinyamin ki-alu vene-yisrael hammitzpa vayyomru bene yisrael dabberu echa nihyeta haraa hazzot
